_comment: BloodHound CE custom node icons for AgentHound's node kinds. Icons CANNOT be supplied in an ingest payload, so AgentHound does not upload this file: it never makes network calls (security invariant 2). You POST it yourself, once per BloodHound instance. See bloodhound/README.md. Keys MUST be the emitted PascalCase kind names, which is why the non-human identity kind is 'Nhi' and not 'NHI' - schema/opengraph.py sanitizes kinds on emit, and a key that does not match renders a (?) icon in the UI. Icon names come from the free, solid Font Awesome set and carry no 'fa-' prefix. Colors are #RRGGBB.
